comparison.objective: Rotate a cabled turntable while preventing cable winding or hooking; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Cable topology management and rotary-stage manipulation versus hex-key insertion, collar adjustment, stabilization, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: Heading within tolerance with cable wrap below 180 degrees and no post loop; no impact-response or lock-drift test.
comparison.reason: Rotation is shared only generically; the record tests cable routing and topology, not continuous mechanism calibration.
